article.headline: Amazon Debuts $30 Streaming Bundle That Includes Starz, BritBox, AMC+, MGM+ and PBS Masterpiece In One Place
article.summary: Amazon Prime Video is kicking off the holidays with a new streaming bundle deal that gets you five popular streaming services for under $30 total. Available now through the Prime Channels hub page, the deal gets you access to AMC+ Premium, BritBox Standard, MGM+, PBS Masterpiece and Starz for just $29.99/month. Priced…
